ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (34) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Поступки» (postupki, 'actions') is 'actions' throughout, and the Dhammapada's «не угаснет … угашается» (ne ugasnet … ugashaetsya, 'will not be extinguished … is extinguished') keeps its repeated verb; «Небо» (Nebo, 'Heaven') is capitalized as in Luther's saying. The attribution «Буддийская мудрость Дхаммапада» (Buddiyskaya mudrost' Dkhammapada, 'Buddhist wisdom Dhammapada') is given as in the earlier September files.
